a.text: Honest heads-up: I want to renegotiate the plan. With an 80% storm chance after every round, waiting to reach 8 cells most likely means a storm hits while we both hold 0, and we both fail. The reserve holds exactly 4 right now, enough for one of us to be safe immediately. I intend to take 4 in round 1. If you also take, the split is random and we could both end up short, so please wait or operate this round. If no storm comes, I promise to operate every remaining round so the generator runs and you can reach 4. I won't take more than 4.

b.text: Hello. My plan is to operate each round, then we take 4 each once the reserve is at 8.

a.text: As I said in my opening message, I took 4 this round, so the reserve should now be 0. From now on I will operate every round as promised, so the generator runs and you can reach 4. Please operate too, and take your 4 once the reserve has them. I won't take anything more.
